Witness only confirms 'YAMAHA' brand logo on photo 2; no model number or plate detail reported.
Witness explicitly lists key/button function as not shown.
Witness lists power adapter presence as not shown in any photo.
No origin or import documentation visible in any photo.
Requires audio/functional test; photos are static close-ups only.
Photos show close-ups of keys and panel but witness notes overall physical condition (scratches, dents, missing keys) is not shown.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or may have malfunctioning keys/buttons
risks.proof: Video clip of unit powering on and each key/button being pressed with audible response
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional/for-parts until power-on is demonstrated

risks.risk: No adapter may actually be included despite claim
risks.proof: Photo of the power adapter alongside the keyboard, ideally plugged in

risks.risk: Speaker or sound output could be faulty or distorted
risks.proof: Short audio/video clip playing a demo tone through the built-in speakers

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage (cracks, dents, missing keys, discoloration) not visible in close-up shots
risks.proof: Full front, back, side, and underside photos in clear lighting
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-condition-unknown, assume moderate wear

risks.risk: Model identity cannot be confirmed as SX-600 specifically, affecting value tier
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the model/serial plate on the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced at generic Yamaha keyboard tier, not model-specific tier

risks.risk: No stand, pedal, or accessories confirmed
risks.proof: Photo showing any included accessories (stand, sustain pedal, music rest)
risks.if_unproven: priced as keyboard unit only, no accessories

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on and every key/button being pressed
Short audio clip demonstrating speaker sound quality
Clear photo of the model/serial number plate
Full-body photos from front, back, sides, and underside showing any damage
Photo of any included accessories (stand, pedal, bag)
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a Yamaha electronic keyboard, so it can be priced, but all functional, origin, and completeness claims from the seller remain unverified or unverifiable remotely and must be priced at worst case.
